piece.keyEstimated: The file has no key signature; judging by its notes it is most likely in {key}.
piece.tempoChanges: The tempo changes within the file, between {min} and {max} BPM.
piece.meterChanges: The time signature changes along the way; it starts in {meter}.
wait: In Wait mode the falling notes stop at each of the {notes} notes until you press the right key, so you can work through {title} at your own pace.
Wait mode pauses {title} at every note and chord until your MIDI keyboard sends the right key. Timing does not count yet, only the notes do.
loop: Drag across the bar strip to loop a passage. With {bars} bars, you can repeat a few at a time until they sit, then widen the loop.
Loop a section by dragging across the bar strip: pick two or three of the {bars} bars, repeat them, then move on to the next ones.
tempo: The tempo control slows the piece down without changing the pitch, so you can start well below {tempo} BPM and work your way up.
Start slower than the original {tempo} BPM: the tempo control changes the speed, not the pitch.
performance: When the notes sit, switch to Performance mode: {title} runs in real time and Pianist rates the timing of every note you play.
Performance mode is the next step: no more waiting, {title} plays in real time and every note gets a timing score.
